medicines.name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen/Tylenol)
medicines.uses: Fever, headache, body pain, mild arthritis
medicines.dosage: 500mg tablet - 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours, max 4000mg/day
medicines.sideEffects: Mild nausea, allergic reactions, liver damage if overdosed
medicines.precautions: Don't exceed 4000mg per day. Avoid if allergic. Use with caution in liver disease

medicines.name: Ibuprofen (Brufen, Advil, Motrin)
medicines.uses: Pain relief, inflammation, fever, arthritis, menstrual cramps
medicines.dosage: 400-600mg tablet - 1-2 tablets every 6-8 hours with food
medicines.sideEffects: Stomach upset, nausea, dizziness, ulcers if overused
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Not suitable for ulcer patients or those on blood thinners

medicines.name: Aspirin
medicines.uses: Heart protection, pain relief, fever, stroke prevention, anti-inflammatory
medicines.dosage: 325-500mg - 1-2 tablets daily, max 3000mg/day for pain
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Not for children under 12. Avoid if allergic to NSAIDs

medicines.name: Diclofenac
medicines.uses: Severe pain, inflammation, arthritis, muscle spasm, dental pain
medicines.dosage: 50mg tablet - 1-2 tablets every 6-8 hours, max 150mg/day
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Don't use for long term. Monitor kidney function

medicines.name: Naproxen
medicines.uses: Pain relief, inflammation, arthritis, menstrual pain, fever
medicines.dosage: 250mg - 1 tablet every 6-8 hours initially, then 250mg every 6-8 hours
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Not suitable for those with cardiovascular disease

medicines.name: Mefenamic Acid
medicines.uses: Menstrual cramps, severe pain, headache, tooth pain
medicines.dosage: 500mg tablet - 1-2 tablets every 6 hours
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Maximum 1 week duration. Not for children under 14

medicines.name: Metamizole (Dipyrone)
medicines.uses: Severe pain, high fever, muscle spasm
medicines.dosage: 500mg - 1-2 tablets every 6-8 hours, max 2000mg/day
medicines.precautions: Banned in some countries. Regular blood monitoring needed

medicines.name: Paracetamol + Codeine
medicines.uses: Moderate to severe pain with cough suppression
medicines.dosage: 500mg paracetamol + 8-15mg codeine every 4-6 hours
medicines.precautions: Avoid driving. Can be habit-forming. Requires prescription

medicines.name: Tramadol
medicines.uses: Moderate to severe pain management
medicines.dosage: 50-100mg every 4-6 hours, max 400mg/day
medicines.precautions: Avoid driving. Can cause addiction. Prescription required

medicines.name: Morphine
medicines.uses: Severe pain, cancer pain, heart attack pain, post-operative pain
medicines.dosage: 5-30mg every 4 hours as needed
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, constipation, nausea, respiratory depression, addiction
medicines.precautions: Controlled substance. Requires doctor prescription. Monitor closely

medicines.name: Cetirizine (Zyrtec, Piriteze)
medicines.uses: Allergies, urticaria, itching, hay fever, allergic rhinitis
medicines.dosage: 10mg tablet - 1 tablet once or twice daily
medicines.precautions: May cause drowsiness. Don't drive after taking. Take with water

medicines.name: Loratadine
medicines.uses: Allergies, hay fever, urticaria, rhinitis
medicines.dosage: 10mg tablet - 1 tablet daily
medicines.precautions: Non-drowsy formula available. Safe for children over 6 years

medicines.name: Fexofenadine
medicines.uses: Allergic rhinitis, urticaria, itching
medicines.dosage: 180mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily
medicines.precautions: Safe for long-term use. Non-sedating. Don't take with fruit juice

medicines.name: Desloratadine
medicines.uses: Allergies, urticaria, allergic rhinitis
medicines.dosage: 5mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily
medicines.precautions: Non-sedating. Safe for children over 6 years

medicines.name: Promethazine
medicines.uses: Allergies, itching, sedation, anti-nausea, anti-motion sickness
medicines.dosage: 25mg tablet - 1 tablet every 4-6 hours as needed
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, blurred vision, dry mouth, constipation
medicines.precautions: Causes drowsiness. Don't drive. Avoid in children under 2 years

medicines.name: Levocetirizine
medicines.uses: Allergic rhinitis, urticaria, allergies
medicines.dosage: 5mg tablet - 1 tablet once or twice daily
medicines.precautions: Non-drowsy formula available. Safe for children over 6 years

medicines.name: Omeprazole
medicines.uses: Stomach acidity, GERD, peptic ulcers, gastritis
medicines.dosage: 20mg capsule - 1 capsule daily before meals for 2-4 weeks
medicines.precautions: Take 30 minutes before meals. Long-term use needs monitoring

medicines.name: Lansoprazole
medicines.uses: GERD, peptic ulcers, acidity, gastritis
medicines.dosage: 30mg capsule - 1 capsule daily before breakfast
medicines.precautions: Take before meals. Can affect vitamin B12 absorption

medicines.name: Pantoprazole
medicines.uses: GERD, erosive esophagitis, acidity, ulcer prevention
medicines.dosage: 40mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily before breakfast
medicines.precautions: Take before meals. Monitor long-term effects

medicines.name: Rabeprazole
medicines.uses: GERD, peptic ulcers, acidity, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
medicines.dosage: 20mg tablet - 1 tablet daily before breakfast
medicines.precautions: Take before meals. May affect vitamin B12 absorption

medicines.name: Famotidine (H2 Blocker)
medicines.uses: Acidity, GERD, peptic ulcers, heartburn
medicines.dosage: 20mg tablet - 1 tablet twice daily or at bedtime
medicines.precautions: Take with or without food. Safe over-the-counter

medicines.name: Antacid (Aluminum Hydroxide + Magnesium Hydroxide)
medicines.uses: Heartburn, acidity, indigestion, stomach upset
medicines.dosage: 2 tablets after meals or as needed, max 8 tablets/day
medicines.precautions: Don't take with other medications. May interfere with absorption

medicines.name: Metoclopramide (Reglan)
medicines.uses: Nausea, vomiting, gastroparesis, GERD
medicines.dosage: 10mg tablet - 1 tablet 3-4 times daily before meals
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, fatigue, dystonia, tardive dyskinesia with long-term use
medicines.precautions: Avoid driving. Long-term use can cause movement disorders

medicines.name: Domperidone
medicines.uses: Nausea, vomiting, gastric reflux, bloating
medicines.dosage: 10mg tablet - 1 tablet 3 times daily before meals
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dry mouth, diarrhea, abdominal cramps
medicines.precautions: Take 15-30 minutes before meals. Don't use with strong light

medicines.name: Loperamide (Imodium)
medicines.uses: Diarrhea, loose stools, traveler's diarrhea
medicines.dosage: 2mg tablet - 1-2 tablets initially, then 1 tablet after each stool, max 8mg/day
medicines.sideEffects: Constipation if overused, abdominal cramps, nausea
medicines.precautions: Max 8mg/day. Don't use if fever present or in dysentery

medicines.name: Ondansetron (Zofran)
medicines.uses: Severe nausea, vomiting, post-operative nausea, chemotherapy nausea
medicines.dosage: 4-8mg tablet - 1 tablet every 6-8 hours
medicines.precautions: Requires prescription. Can cause constipation

medicines.name: Amoxicillin
medicines.uses: Bacterial infections, throat infection, respiratory infections, UTI, ear infection
medicines.dosage: 500mg - 1 tablet three times daily for 7-10 days
medicines.precautions: Complete full course. Don't skip doses. Allergic to penicillin? Don't use

medicines.name: Cephalexin
medicines.uses: Bacterial infections, skin infections, respiratory infections, UTI
medicines.dosage: 500mg tablet - 1 tablet four times daily for 7-10 days
medicines.precautions: Complete full course. May cross-react in penicillin allergies

medicines.name: Ciprofloxacin (Cipro)
medicines.uses: Bacterial infections, UTI, respiratory infections, gastroenteritis
medicines.dosage: 500mg tablet - 1 tablet twice daily for 7-10 days
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, diarrhea, headache, photosensitivity, tendon problems
medicines.precautions: Avoid sunlight. Not for children. May weaken tendons

medicines.name: Azithromycin
medicines.uses: Respiratory infections, throat infection, sexual transmitted infections, atypical pneumonia
medicines.dosage: 500mg - 1 tablet on day 1, then 1 tablet daily for 4 days
medicines.precautions: Take on empty stomach. Can cause QT prolongation

medicines.name: Tetracycline
medicines.uses: Acne, respiratory infections, UTI, sexually transmitted infections
medicines.dosage: 500mg tablet - 1 tablet four times daily
medicines.precautions: Avoid sunlight. Don't take with milk. Avoid in children under 12

medicines.name: Doxycycline
medicines.uses: Acne, respiratory infections, Lyme disease, malaria prevention
medicines.dosage: 100mg tablet - 1 tablet twice daily
medicines.sideEffects: Photosensitivity, nausea, esophageal ulcers, yeast infection
medicines.precautions: Avoid sunlight. Take with water. Avoid in children under 12 and pregnancy

medicines.name: Metronidazole (Flagyl)
medicines.uses: Parasitic infections, bacterial vaginosis, trichomoniasis, amoebic infections
medicines.dosage: 500mg - 1 tablet three times daily for 7 days
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, metallic taste, headache, dark urine, yeast infection
medicines.precautions: Avoid alcohol. Metallic taste is normal. Complete full course

medicines.name: Fluconazole (Diflucan)
medicines.uses: Fungal infections, Candida, yeast infections, cryptococcal meningitis
medicines.dosage: 150mg capsule - 1 capsule as single dose or as directed
medicines.precautions: Can interact with many medications. Monitor liver function

medicines.name: Clotrimazole Cream
medicines.uses: Fungal infections, athlete's foot, ringworm, jock itch, Candida
medicines.dosage: 1% cream - Apply thin layer 2-3 times daily for 2-4 weeks
medicines.precautions: Clean and dry area before application. Wash hands after use

medicines.name: Miconazole Cream
medicines.uses: Fungal infections, ringworm, jock itch, diaper rash, Candida
medicines.dosage: 2% cream - Apply thin layer 2-3 times daily
medicines.precautions: Clean area before application. Avoid contact with eyes

medicines.name: Terbinafine
medicines.uses: Severe fungal infections, nail fungus, ringworm, athlete's foot
medicines.dosage: 250mg tablet - 1 tablet daily for 6-12 weeks
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, headache, taste changes, liver problems, rash
medicines.precautions: Requires prescription. Monitor liver function. Avoid in liver disease

medicines.name: Ketoconazole
medicines.uses: Fungal infections, Candida, ringworm, seborrheic dermatitis
medicines.dosage: 200mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily with food
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, headache, liver toxicity, adrenal insufficiency
medicines.precautions: Monitor liver function. Can cause serious liver damage

medicines.name: Hydrocortisone Cream
medicines.uses: Skin inflammation, eczema, dermatitis, psoriasis, itching
medicines.dosage: 1% cream - Apply thin layer 2-3 times daily
medicines.sideEffects: Burning, itching, skin thinning if overused, hypopigmentation
medicines.precautions: Don't use on face for long. Use lowest effective dose

medicines.name: Calamine Lotion
medicines.uses: Itching, mosquito bites, rashes, minor cuts, insect stings
medicines.dosage: Apply directly to affected area 2-3 times daily
medicines.precautions: Avoid contact with eyes and mouth. Use as needed

medicines.name: Salicylic Acid (Wart Remover)
medicines.uses: Warts, corns, calluses, acne, psoriasis
medicines.dosage: Apply 2-3 times daily, available in various strengths (15-40%)
medicines.precautions: Avoid healthy skin. Use on warts only. Wash hands after use

medicines.name: Benzoyl Peroxide
medicines.uses: Acne, mild to moderate acne vulgaris
medicines.dosage: Apply 2.5-10% gel/cream once or twice daily
medicines.sideEffects: Dryness, peeling, redness, burning, bleaching of fabrics
medicines.precautions: Avoid contact with eyes. Can bleach fabrics. May cause bleached appearance

medicines.name: Tretinoin (Retin-A)
medicines.uses: Acne, wrinkles, sun damage, aging skin
medicines.dosage: 0.025-0.1% cream/gel - Apply once daily at night, start low and increase
medicines.sideEffects: Dryness, peeling, redness, photosensitivity, birth defects if pregnant
medicines.precautions: Prescription required. Avoid sunlight. Don't use during pregnancy

medicines.name: Adapalene (Differin)
medicines.uses: Acne, comedones, post-acne marks
medicines.dosage: 0.1% gel - Apply once daily at night
medicines.precautions: Avoid sunlight. Don't use during pregnancy. Start with low dose

medicines.name: Coal Tar
medicines.uses: Psoriasis, eczema, seborrheic dermatitis, itching
medicines.dosage: Apply as directed, usually 1-3 times daily
medicines.precautions: Avoid sunlight. Can stain clothing and skin. Wash hands thoroughly

medicines.name: Permethrin Cream (Scabies Treatment)
medicines.uses: Scabies, lice, mange
medicines.dosage: 5% cream - Apply to entire body from neck down, leave for 8-14 hours
medicines.precautions: Apply to entire family. Wash clothing after treatment

medicines.name: Metformin
medicines.uses: Type 2 diabetes, PCOS, metabolic syndrome
medicines.dosage: 500mg-1000mg tablet - 1-3 tablets daily in divided doses with meals
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, diarrhea, metallic taste, vitamin B12 deficiency, lactic acidosis
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Regular blood sugar monitoring. Avoid in kidney disease

medicines.name: Glibenclamide (Glyburide)
medicines.uses: Type 2 diabetes management
medicines.dosage: 5mg tablet - 1-2 tablets daily, usually with breakfast
medicines.precautions: Monitor blood sugar. Risk of hypoglycemia. Don't skip meals

medicines.name: Insulin
medicines.uses: Type 1 diabetes, Type 2 diabetes when oral meds fail
medicines.dosage: Varies based on type and individual needs - Injection
medicines.sideEffects: Hypoglycemia, weight gain, injection site reactions, lipohypertrophy
medicines.precautions: Requires injection. Monitor blood sugar closely. Risk of hypoglycemia

medicines.name: Lisinopril
medicines.uses: High blood pressure, heart failure, post-MI protection
medicines.dosage: 10-40mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily
medicines.sideEffects: Cough, dizziness, low blood pressure, hyperkalemia, kidney dysfunction
medicines.precautions: Monitor blood pressure. Don't use in pregnancy. Regular kidney function tests

medicines.name: Enalapril
medicines.uses: High blood pressure, heart failure
medicines.dosage: 5-20mg tablet - 1-2 tablets daily, usually in one dose
medicines.precautions: Monitor blood pressure. Don't use in pregnancy. Check kidney function

medicines.name: Ramipril
medicines.uses: High blood pressure, heart failure, post-MI protection, diabetic nephropathy
medicines.dosage: 2.5-10mg capsule - 1 capsule once or twice daily
medicines.sideEffects: Dry cough, dizziness, fatigue, hyperkalemia, kidney dysfunction
medicines.precautions: Monitor blood pressure. Don't use in pregnancy

medicines.name: Amlodipine
medicines.uses: High blood pressure, angina
medicines.dosage: 5-10mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily
medicines.sideEffects: Ankle swelling, headache, flushing, fatigue, nausea
medicines.precautions: Avoid grapefruit juice. Don't stop suddenly. Monitor heart rate

medicines.name: Metoprolol
medicines.uses: High blood pressure, angina, heart failure, post-MI protection, arrhythmia
medicines.dosage: 25-100mg tablet - 1-3 tablets daily in divided doses
medicines.sideEffects: Fatigue, dizziness, low blood pressure, slow heart rate, depression, impotence
medicines.precautions: Don't stop suddenly. Monitor heart rate and blood pressure

medicines.name: Atenolol
medicines.uses: High blood pressure, angina, heart attack, arrhythmia
medicines.dosage: 50-100mg tablet - 1 tablet once or twice daily
medicines.sideEffects: Fatigue, dizziness, slow heart rate, sexual dysfunction, depression
medicines.precautions: Don't stop suddenly. Monitor heart rate. May mask hypoglycemia

medicines.name: Atorvastatin
medicines.uses: High cholesterol, cardiovascular disease prevention
medicines.dosage: 10-80mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily usually at night
medicines.sideEffects: Muscle pain, liver dysfunction, nausea, memory problems
medicines.precautions: Don't use in pregnancy. Monitor liver enzymes. Avoid high fat diet

medicines.name: Simvastatin
medicines.uses: High cholesterol, cardiovascular disease prevention
medicines.dosage: 10-40mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily usually at night
medicines.sideEffects: Muscle pain, liver dysfunction, nausea, fatigue
medicines.precautions: Don't use in pregnancy. Monitor liver function

medicines.name: Warfarin
medicines.uses: Blood clots prevention, atrial fibrillation, post-MI, thrombosis
medicines.dosage: 2-10mg tablet - Dosage varies, requires INR monitoring
medicines.sideEffects: Bleeding, bruising, rash, nausea, hair loss
medicines.precautions: Requires INR monitoring. Avoid NSAIDs. Drug and food interactions

medicines.name: Aspirin (Blood Thinner)
medicines.uses: Heart attack prevention, stroke prevention, blood clot prevention
medicines.dosage: 75-100mg tablet - 1 tablet once daily
medicines.sideEffects: Bleeding, stomach upset, ulcers, allergic reactions
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Monitor for bleeding signs

medicines.name: Heparin (Injection)
medicines.uses: Blood clots prevention, acute thrombosis, PE prevention
medicines.dosage: Injection - Dosage varies based on indication and weight
medicines.precautions: Requires monitoring. Check platelets. Monitor for bleeding

medicines.name: Vitamin B12
medicines.uses: B12 deficiency, anemia, pernicious anemia, neurological disorders
medicines.dosage: 1000mcg - 1 tablet daily or monthly injection
medicines.sideEffects: None significant, rarely headache or dizziness
medicines.precautions: Safe for long-term use. Injections more effective than oral

medicines.name: Vitamin D3
medicines.uses: Vitamin D deficiency, bone health, calcium absorption, immune function
medicines.dosage: 1000-4000 IU daily
medicines.sideEffects: None significant if appropriate dose. Hypercalcemia if overdosed
medicines.precautions: Get levels checked before supplementing. Take with meals

medicines.name: Iron Supplement
medicines.uses: Iron deficiency, anemia, blood loss
medicines.dosage: 325mg ferrous sulfate - 1 tablet daily, preferably at night
medicines.sideEffects: Constipation, nausea, dark stools, abdominal discomfort
medicines.precautions: Take with vitamin C for better absorption. Avoid with tea/coffee

medicines.name: Zinc Supplement
medicines.uses: Immunity boost, wound healing, cold prevention, taste restoration
medicines.dosage: 10-25mg daily
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, metallic taste, headache, copper deficiency if overused
medicines.precautions: Don't exceed 40mg daily long-term. May interfere with antibiotics

medicines.name: Calcium Supplement
medicines.uses: Bone health, pregnancy support, osteoporosis prevention
medicines.dosage: 1000-1200mg daily
medicines.sideEffects: Constipation, nausea, kidney stones if excessive
medicines.precautions: Take with vitamin D for better absorption. Don't exceed RDA

medicines.name: Magnesium Supplement
medicines.uses: Muscle cramps, sleep problems, constipation, migraine prevention
medicines.dosage: 300-400mg daily
medicines.sideEffects: Diarrhea, nausea, muscle weakness if overdosed
medicines.precautions: May cause diarrhea. Take with food. Monitor kidney function

medicines.name: Folic Acid
medicines.uses: Folate deficiency, pregnancy support, anemia prevention
medicines.dosage: 400mcg tablet - 1 tablet daily
medicines.sideEffects: None significant, rarely rash or nausea
medicines.precautions: Essential during pregnancy. May interact with medications

medicines.name: Prenatal Vitamins
medicines.uses: Pregnancy nutrition support, fetal development
medicines.dosage: 1 tablet daily
medicines.precautions: Essential during pregnancy and lactation. Start before conception

medicines.name: Levonorgestrel (Emergency Contraceptive)
medicines.uses: Emergency contraception within 72 hours of unprotected intercourse
medicines.dosage: 1.5mg tablet - 1 tablet as single dose
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, fatigue, headache, altered menstrual cycle
medicines.precautions: Not for regular contraception. More effective within 24 hours

medicines.name: Mifepristone
medicines.uses: Medical abortion within first 49 days of pregnancy
medicines.dosage: 200mg tablet - Medical supervision required
medicines.precautions: Requires medical supervision. Legal status varies by country

medicines.name: Ibuprofen (Dysmenorrhea)
medicines.uses: Severe menstrual pain and cramps
medicines.dosage: 400-600mg - 1-2 tablets every 6-8 hours
medicines.precautions: Take with food. Start at first sign of cramps

medicines.name: Oral Contraceptive Pill
medicines.uses: Pregnancy prevention, menstrual regulation, acne
medicines.dosage: 1 tablet daily for 21-28 days depending on formulation
medicines.sideEffects: Nausea, headache, mood changes, breast tenderness, blood clots rare
medicines.precautions: Requires prescription. Increased risk with smoking
medicines.brand_names: Oral Contraceptive, Birth Control Pill, OCP

medicines.name: Baby Multivitamin
medicines.uses: Child development, immunity, nutritional support
medicines.dosage: As per age - consult pediatrician, usually 5ml daily
medicines.sideEffects: Diarrhea if overdosed, rarely allergic reactions
medicines.precautions: Only use prescribed doses. Store safely away from children

medicines.name: Infant Formula
medicines.uses: Infant nutrition when breastfeeding not possible
medicines.dosage: As per age and weight - follow package instructions
medicines.sideEffects: Allergic reactions in lactose intolerance, gas, constipation
medicines.precautions: Use sterilized bottles. Follow preparation instructions carefully

medicines.name: Teething Gel
medicines.uses: Baby teething pain and discomfort relief
medicines.dosage: Apply gel to affected gum area
medicines.precautions: Don't exceed recommended frequency. Ensure hygiene

medicines.name: Paracetamol (Baby)
medicines.uses: Baby fever and pain relief
medicines.dosage: Based on age/weight - 15mg/kg per dose every 4-6 hours
medicines.precautions: Never exceed recommended dose. Use with accurate measurement

medicines.name: Ibuprofen (Baby)
medicines.uses: Baby fever and pain relief (over 3 months)
medicines.dosage: Based on age/weight - 5-10mg/kg per dose
medicines.precautions: Only for babies over 3 months. Use accurate measurement

medicines.name: Saline Nasal Spray
medicines.uses: Nasal congestion, sinusitis, allergic rhinitis, nasal polyp
medicines.dosage: 1-2 sprays in each nostril 2-3 times daily
medicines.precautions: Safe for all ages including babies

medicines.name: Ofloxacin Ear Drops
medicines.uses: Ear infection, otitis externa, swimmer's ear
medicines.dosage: 2-3 drops twice daily for 7 days
medicines.precautions: Don't use if eardrum perforated. Ensure dry applicator

medicines.name: Ciprofloxacin Ear Drops
medicines.uses: Ear infections, swimmer's ear, chronic otitis
medicines.dosage: 2-3 drops twice daily for 7 days
medicines.precautions: Don't use if eardrum perforated

medicines.name: Fluticasone Nasal Spray
medicines.uses: Allergic rhinitis, nasal polyp, sinusitis
medicines.dosage: 1-2 sprays in each nostril once daily
medicines.precautions: Avoid nasal septal perforation. Long-term safety monitor

medicines.name: Antihistamine Nasal Spray
medicines.uses: Allergic rhinitis, sneezing, nasal itching
medicines.dosage: 1-2 sprays in each nostril once or twice daily
medicines.precautions: May cause drowsiness. Check compatibility with other medications

medicines.name: Honey (Cough Remedy)
medicines.uses: Cough suppression, sore throat, throat irritation
medicines.dosage: 1-2 tablespoons as needed, can mix with warm water
medicines.sideEffects: Rare allergic reactions, botulism risk in infants under 1 year
medicines.precautions: Don't give to children under 1 year. Use raw honey for benefits

medicines.name: Ginger
medicines.uses: Nausea, digestive issues, cold symptoms, anti-inflammatory
medicines.dosage: Fresh ginger tea - 1-2 cups daily
medicines.sideEffects: Rarely heartburn, mouth irritation, allergic reactions
medicines.precautions: May interact with blood thinners. Avoid in pregnancy complications

medicines.name: Turmeric (Curcumin)
medicines.uses: Anti-inflammatory, joint pain, digestive health, immune support
medicines.dosage: 500-2000mg daily in divided doses
medicines.precautions: May interact with blood thinners. Avoid if gallbladder problems

medicines.name: Garlic Supplement
medicines.uses: Immune support, cardiovascular health, antibiotic properties
medicines.dosage: 1-2 cloves daily or supplement as directed
medicines.sideEffects: Bad breath, stomach upset, bleeding risk if combined with blood thinners
medicines.precautions: May interact with blood thinners. Avoid before surgery

medicines.name: Echinacea
medicines.uses: Cold prevention, immune boost, upper respiratory infection
medicines.dosage: 300-500mg three times daily
medicines.precautions: Not for autoimmune disorders. May interact with medications

medicines.name: Elderberry
medicines.uses: Cold/flu symptoms, immune support, antiviral
medicines.dosage: 1-2 tablespoons syrup or as per supplement directions
medicines.precautions: May interact with anticoagulants. Consult before use

medicines.name: Probiotics
medicines.uses: Gut health, diarrhea, IBS, lactose intolerance
medicines.dosage: 10 billion to 1 trillion CFU daily
medicines.precautions: Refrigerate if required. Strain-specific benefits vary

medicines.name: Fiber Supplement
medicines.uses: Constipation, digestive health, cholesterol management
medicines.dosage: 5-10g daily with plenty of water
medicines.precautions: Drink plenty of water. Gradually increase dosage

medicines.name: Melatonin
medicines.uses: Insomnia, jet lag, sleep disorders
medicines.dosage: 0.5-10mg before bedtime
medicines.precautions: Natural supplement. May interact with medications

medicines.name: Valerian Root
medicines.uses: Insomnia, anxiety, sleep disorders
medicines.dosage: 400-900mg before bedtime
medicines.precautions: May interact with other medications. Not for long-term use

medicines.name: Passionflower
medicines.uses: Anxiety, sleep disorders, nervousness
medicines.dosage: 45-90mg daily in divided doses
medicines.precautions: May cause drowsiness. Avoid driving after use

medicines.name: Chamomile Tea
medicines.uses: Anxiety, relaxation, sleep aid, digestive relief
medicines.dosage: 1-2 cups before bedtime
medicines.precautions: May interact with blood thinners. Safe for most people

medicines.name: Lavender
medicines.uses: Anxiety, relaxation, sleep aid, stress relief
medicines.dosage: Aromatherapy: diffuse. Tea: 1-2 cups daily
medicines.precautions: Can lower blood pressure. Avoid if already low
medicines.brand_names: Lavender, Lavender Essential Oil, Lavender Extract

medicines.name: Peppermint Oil
medicines.uses: IBS, bloating, digestive cramping, bad breath
medicines.dosage: 1-2 capsules 2-3 times daily
medicines.sideEffects: Heartburn, nausea, allergic reactions, mouth irritation
medicines.precautions: Can relax esophageal sphincter. Avoid if GERD present

medicines.name: Glucosamine
medicines.uses: Arthritis, joint pain, cartilage protection
medicines.dosage: 1500mg daily in divided doses
medicines.precautions: Derived from shellfish - avoid if allergic. Results take time

medicines.name: Chondroitin
medicines.uses: Arthritis, joint pain, cartilage health
